company.name: IQ Data
company.shortDescription: Specialising in geo-location data, with a focus on high accuracy of signals, through a highly advanced and complex processing engine.
company.description:
The leading location data solutions company for the Middle East and Africa.

We began our journey back in 2016 as IQ Wifi, with the aim of helping venue owners leverage existing Wifi networks as a largely untapped resource for customer data collection and venue intelligence. In 2018 we re-branded to IQ data and expanded our focus to all forms of location data both in-venues and outside around the world. Today IQ data provides products and consulting services to help our clients and partners build data-driven strategies whether to surface new customer insights, optimize retail layouts or build complete data strategies from the ground-up.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Angel round raised $1,000,000, or 74.07% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,350,000 to $6,773,310, a 2.88x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 20 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 39 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
